{{Quote|According to intelligence reports, without power, the Imperial base entered Mantooine's atmosphere and broke up by 02740. It is unknown whether the Imperials discovered — or lived to report — the theft of the computer.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Madine's]] report about [[Operation Cobolt]]|<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained an '''orbital base''' around [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]]. It was the target of [[Operation Cobolt]], an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] operation to recover a new [[Scandoc decoding computer]], and to destroy the base.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|416|Operation Cobolt}}</ref>
